prompt: Vertical 9:16 photograph through the half-open back door of the same small British corner shop at night, looking into its cramped stockroom. A single bare fluorescent tube throws hard cold teal light down onto plain brown cardboard cases, unlabelled, stacked floor to ceiling on two pallets and still sealed in clear shrink-wrap, the plastic catching the light. Enough to refill the empty shelf out front about four times over, neat and untouched, a dusty delivery note pinned to the wrap. Foreground: the edge of the door and the dim shop aisle. No people. Shot on Cinestill 800T, pronounced grain, slight halation, deep shadows in the corners, quiet and accusing. Thanks.
